title: docs(pm-dispatch, os-dev): the claim template and the dev definition carry the `Metadata-protocol:` line beside `Clause-②:`
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg4pchBqTn9cQG5gfEpLYo8a)_

Fixes #25115

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

The `.claude/**` half of the maintainer's ruling A on changeset levels (the level follows the metadata protocol alone): the fleet's own dispatch path now knows the `Metadata-protocol:` declaration line that PR #25114 installed beside `Clause-②:`.

- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` — the claim template carries `Metadata-protocol: added | narrowed | semantic | none` right under `Clause-②: yes | no`, with a parenthetical pointing the seat at the level table by its subject (AGENTS.md's Post-Task Checklist, step 3) and naming the two bodies the dev copies it into.
- `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` — the claim-copy rule widens from one line to the pair and names both carriers: the two lines are copied verbatim at line start into the PR body, and into every changeset body, where `Check Changeset` reads them (a kind grades `minor`, `none` grades `patch`). Same 「无则零写,⛔ 不自造」 discipline.
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md` — claim step ② names the third line-initial key, and the `Clause-②` spelling rule gains a sibling: the four values and the level table live in AGENTS.md's Post-Task Checklist ③.

Not touched, by measurement: `references/contract-review.md` and `references/landing-operations.md` route the contract review on `Clause-②` (the review tier follows the FACE of the diff, the level follows the KIND), so neither needs to read the kind; `os-dev.md`'s dogfood trigger still reads the `(narrowing)` arm. The reader (`scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs`), the level axis (`check-changeset-no-major.mjs`), `AGENTS.md` and `pr-automation.yml` are out of scope and unchanged.

## Line budget (`check:pm-skill-ratchet`, every file at headroom 0 on the base)

| File | Base | Head | Paid with |
|:--|--:|--:|:--|
| `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` | 319 / 319 | 318 / 319 | +1 template line; −2: the template caption line 「认领评论(英文,固定形状;首行字面 `Claim:`):」 and its trailing blank. Its content is carried by execution-duties ② (「认领评论照抄 SKILL.md 模板」), SKILL.md 全体座位的不变量 (GitHub 上一切新内容用英文) and AGENTS.md (the identity record is the `Claim:` comment, first line beginning `Claim:`). |
| `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` | 404 / 404 | 404 / 404 | +1 (the copy rule is now two lines); −1: 「正文以 session-URL 形式的署名页脚收尾(见字节与 sanitizer 纪律节)。」, an intra-file pointer to the footer block two sections down, whose own annotation already says 「session-URL:创建 PR 正文用」 (and AGENTS.md's identical block says "session-URL: use in PR BODIES"). First candidate measured and rejected: the commit-trailer rule 「卡片关系只在 PR 正文声明一次…」 is quoted verbatim by `scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs`, whose self-test pins the quotation to the file, so deleting it reds `check:commit-card-trailers`. |
| `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md` | 188 / 188 | 187 / 188 | +1 (the kind pointer); −2: the preamble line 「执行席每次 fire 读本文:候选、认领、派发、收集、复核;落地窗口另读 `landing-operations.md`。」 and its trailing blank. SKILL.md's 阶段细则索引 rows carry the same reader, moment and sections for this file and for landing-operations.md. |

No line was re-wrapped; every new bullet is under the 120-byte cap (110 / 111 / 114 / 113 B); every sentence a script quotes from these files is still there verbatim (measured with a scan of `scripts/**`, `.github/**`, `.githooks/**` and `.claude/hooks/**` for each edited file's base lines). The four-axis frame is untouched (md5 of its 21 lines: `abff5f852c8fd09b79ec0623439aa4f0`, same as on the base). The two ceilings left at headroom 1 can be lowered to 318 and 187 by the seat at landing or in the next tooling PR; `scripts/**` is outside this card's surface.

## Proof the new lines read

- `node scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs --dry-run --comment=25115 --file=claim.md` on a claim written from the new template (both lines at line start): exit 0, `Stamp verdict: stamped-by-this-act`, no keyed-line refusal.
- `scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs` imported directly over a PR-body sample and a changeset-body sample carrying both lines: `readClause2Line` → `declared no` / `declared yes (widening)`; `readMetadataProtocolLine` → `declared none` / `declared added` (trailing reasoning ignored, as the reader documents). The template placeholders themselves read `malformed`, as they should — a seat that forgets to fill the line is refused, never read as `none`.
- This PR body carries both lines at line start, which is the behaviour the card installs.

`check:skill-frame-freshness` (local-only family) was not run: the worktree is at `origin/main` 03de83bfe plus this one commit, and the frame block is untouched. The whole-tree farm, the type-check lanes and `Check Changeset` are CI's; the PR check-runs are the record for those. No package is touched, so there is no ① build closure and no ② package test to owe; no changeset is written (`.claude/**` is the fast lane, nothing is published, `skip-changeset` rides the create).

One interim red worth recording: the first payment chosen for os-dev.md deleted its commit-trailer rule line, and `check:commit-card-trailers --self-test` went red because that script quotes the sentence verbatim and pins the quotation to the file. The line was restored and the footer-pointer line paid instead; the final run above is on that tree.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

### 改了什么
PM 派发技能的认领模板、os-dev 开发定义和执行席细则,补上 `Metadata-protocol: added | narrowed | semantic | none` 这一行:席位认领时申报本卡改了元数据作者能写的什么,dev 把它和 `Clause-②:` 一起原样抄进 PR 正文和每个 changeset 正文。三个文件各加一行、各删一行付棘轮账,不动任何脚本。

### 为什么改
你 10-21 的裁决 A 定了「changeset 定级只随元数据协议」,PR #25114 把读这一行的门禁落了地,但派发路径自己还不知道这行:模板只有 `Clause-②:`,os-dev 定义还写着「无则零写、不自造」。结果每个带 changeset 的派发 PR 都会先吃一次 `not-measured-material` 红,changeset 里也没有发布说明分组要的 kind。这张卡是裁决 A 没落地的那一半。

### 风险与代价(含回滚)
纯规则文本,`.claude/**` 受管面 Tier S,CI 门禁(棘轮、id-lint、frame-sync 等)全绿才入队。风险只在删掉的三行是否真的冗余:模板题注(内容在执行席细则与 AGENTS.md)、commit trailer 规则(pre-push 门禁 check-commit-card-trailers 机械强制,AGENTS.md 已载)、执行席细则文首导读(SKILL.md 索引行已载)。回滚 = revert 本 PR,无数据、无运行时影响。

### 席位意见
(席位填写)

### 你要做的
无需动作:Tier S 由 skills 席位契约复核 PASS 后入队落地。

## Acceptance notes

- Out-of-scope observation, carrier: the skills seat at landing — `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` ceilings for SKILL.md (319 → 318) and execution-duties.md (188 → 187) can be lowered; `scripts/**` is outside this card's declared surface.
- Out-of-scope observation, noted, not filed — `scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs` pins one os-dev.md sentence verbatim, and no index says which rule lines are script-pinned; a future ratchet payment finds out by running the gate, as this one did.
- Out-of-scope observation, noted, not filed — the first line of this PR body is the harness-prescribed HTML-comment attribution marker, which os-dev.md's 干净收尾 forbids in GitHub text; the seat's #25214 review already queued a skills card for that conflict (its OOS-2), so nothing new is filed here.
- Standing conflict reported, not silently resolved: the dispatch order asked the card thread to post the `Claim:` and write the assignee; the runbook that landed with #25214 (〈卡线程(mode:thread)〉) and AGENTS.md give both acts to the seat, so the thread handed the seat a dry-run-clean claim text and started after the seat posted it.
